samples.map:
- dialog "地図と録画要項":
  - text: ペレルマンの現地調査コンソール
  - heading "地図と録画要項" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Main & Church · 2041
  - text: 9件中5件を録画
  - button "地図と現地調査要項を閉じる": ×
  - region "オリジナル地図でロックヴィルを移動":
    - text: ロックヴィル街路地図
    - strong: 目的地を選ぶ
    - text: 印の付いた調査地点はペレルマンの要項に基づきます。
    - img "1985年版オリジナルのロックヴィル中心街地図"
    - button "Zoological Garden"
    - button "Aquarium"
    - button "Riverside Park"
    - button "Railroad Museum"
    - button "ノース・セントラル駅"
    - button "Halley Museum"
    - button "Huang Hall"
    - button "インフォテック・ビル"
    - button "St. Michael's Church"
    - button "ケネディ公園"
    - button "Main Library"
    - button "レストラン、調査目的地": レストラン
    - button "市役所、調査目的地": 市役所
    - button "発電所、調査目的地": 発電所
    - button "新聞、調査目的地": 新聞
    - button "Transit, fieldwork destination": Transit
    - button "裁判所、調査目的地": 裁判所
    - button "Cinema, fieldwork destination": Cinema
    - button "Your apartment, fieldwork destination": Your apartment
    - text: 目的地への経路
    - strong: St. Michael's Church
    - text: あと2ステップ · 次は NORTH（Church Entrance方面）
    - button "次の移動を入力欄へ"
    - button "解除"
  - region "現地調査チェックリスト":
    - text: ペレルマンの調査要項
    - strong: 9件中5件を録画
    - text: 体験中は RECORD を有効にしてください。チェックは Release 79 と同じ反応を手がかりにする補助的な推定です。
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: レストランで食事をすること
        - text: レストラン
        - button "レストランで食事をすることへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 政府職員と話すこと
        - text: 市役所
        - button "政府職員と話すことへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 発電施設を訪れること
        - text: 発電所
        - button "発電施設を訪れることへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 新聞を読むこと
        - text: 新聞
        - button "新聞を読むことへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 何らかの公共交通機関に乗ること
        - text: Transit
        - button "何らかの公共交通機関に乗ることへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 開廷中の裁判を傍聴すること
        - text: 裁判所
        - button "開廷中の裁判を傍聴することへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 教会関係者と話すこと
        - text: St. Michael's Church
        - button "教会関係者と話すことへの経路を表示": 経路を表示中
      - listitem:
        - strong: 映画を見に行くこと
        - text: Cinema
        - button "映画を見に行くことへの経路を表示": 地図で表示
      - listitem:
        - strong: 自分の家、または居住区を訪れること
        - text: Your apartment
        - button "自分の家、または居住区を訪れることへの経路を表示": 地図で表示

lines.text: The headline story in the news section is about the Index of Leading Economic Indicators, which are up a stunning 9.7% over last month, yet another indication of the economy's robust performance. Related stories discuss the unemployment rate, which is at the lowest level in almost thirty years, and commercial and housing construction, which are at an all-time high.

lines.text: Another major story covers President Ryder's speech for the Distinguished Lecturer Series of the Border Security Force Academy. In his address, the President called the '40s a "decade of new hope," and attributed much of that new hope to the work of the BSF, sending a signal to the entire world that the USNA "won't be pushed around by the biggest dictatorship or the smallest band of terrorist murderers."

lines.text: On one of the inside pages, an in-depth report on crime reveals that, although the overall crime rate has dropped only 4% over the last decade, public perception is that crime has fallen much further. The report attributes this perception to three points: Violent crime has decreased much faster than other types of crime, and is down by 15% from ten years ago. Crime in the schools, which has always gotten the most publicity, has dropped by 40%. Most importantly, offenders are getting harsher sentences, as opposed to the old days of getting off on technicalities, low bail, and easy parole.

lines.text: You order a bowl of Hot and Sour soup and some assorted appetizers. The food arrives promptly, steaming hot, delicately spiced, delicious. Afterward, your check arrives with a typical fortune cookie and a plate of lychee nuts. The fortune reads: "Prosperity does not equal happiness." You pay with your credit card. After a moment, the waiter returns your card, informing you that your account has been debited for $30 and that your new balance is $569.

lines.text: You have crossed the proverbial railroad tracks. The optimism and economic recovery don't seem to have spilled over into this run-down section of Rockvil, near the river. Wicker Drive, which runs northeast to southwest, cuts perpendicularly across River Street here. To the northwest, River dips under an unused rail bridge. There are factories on the northern and eastern corners. To the west is a dingy warehouse, and south of here are some dilapidated apartments. The smell of stale urine wafts from a stairway leading down to a gloomy Tube station.
